scoring_justification: The main claim concerns counts of zero-energy Majorana corner modes and quantized invariants (FWS at 0.5, FQM at 0/0.5). A full recompute of a continuous metric is not applicable; instead we verify these discrete structural signatures by counting near-zero quasienergies and near-0.5 eigenvalues with appropriate tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected counts of near-zero quasienergies and near-0.5 Wannier eigenvalues, and expected quadrupole moment values.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's explicit numerical claims. No synthetic fabrication.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Targets are the paper's reported numbers for the same conditions and metrics.

schema.description: Sorted list of 5000 real Floquet quasienergies.

outputs.description: Floquet quasienergy spectrum for B_x=0. The checker will verify the number of quasienergies with |μ| < 1e-5 equals the expected count for this phase.

output_contract.notes: Outputs cover the 2D FSOTSC core: quasienergy/Majorana corner modes and topological invariants. The checker validates discrete structural signatures against paper-derived thresholds.
